en: You beat my husband? My, my! Then you've earned this. It's something I keep for strong Trainers.
HM02 is Fly. With the Storm Badge, your Pokémon can carry you to any town you've visited before.
My husband is the Gym Leader. He's out there under that waterfall day and night, bellowing at it.
If you ever beat him, come and find me. I've got something for a Trainer like that.
Is Fly treating you well? Soaring over the sea is lovely on a calm day.
Suicune bounded off across the sea!
Did you see it? Suicune! I've chased it all the way from the Burned Tower, and it went straight past me to look at you.
I'm Eusine. I've studied Suicune for ten years. Why would it look at you? I have to know. Battle me, {player}!
I lost... So that's it. You and your Pokémon share something Suicune can sense.
I'll keep searching. Suicune won't be far. Next time, I'll be the one it waits for!
